question: For Total Dissolved Solids, Net Increase at Outfall 001, on which calendar date within Federal FY2025 does governance switch from the footnote *10 numeric limits (27,664 lbs/day and 497 mg/L 30-day averages) to the footnote *11 numeric limits (24,992 lbs/day and 449 mg/L 30-day averages), given that *10 applies from the permit effective date through 3 years from that date and *11 applies beginning 3 years from the permit effective date?
source_locator: farmington/final_permit.pdf page 5 section part_i (Total Dissolved Solids, Net Increase rows; footnotes *10 and *11)
semantic_arguments: Federal FY2025 evaluation window: 2024-10-01 through 2025-09-30 inclusive
Footnote *10: limits begin on the effective date and last through 3 years from the permit effective date
Footnote *11: limits apply during the period beginning 3 years from the permit effective date through permit expiration
Interpretation of inclusive vs exclusive boundary at the third-anniversary date (whether *10 and *11 overlap, abut, or leave a gap)
Schedule of Compliance statement that 449 mg/L compliance is required 3 years after the permit effective date (page 6, Section B item 2)
notes: Federal FY2025 spans both the tail end of the *10 period and the bulk of the *11 period. Different readings of when the three-year mark occurs and whether the transition date belongs to *10 or *11 would assign different enforceable 30-day average limits to reported measurements in October–December 2024 and therefore change exceedance determinations under Purpose A.
